schema.name: nx_sim_convection
schema.description: Create assumed convection on 1..1000 distinct SIM occurrence face IDs from nx_sim_faces. Requires the active NX MULTIPHYSICS Thermal solution; Flow/coupled solutions are rejected to avoid imposing assumed convection on solved interfaces. coefficient_w_m2_k is positive finite W/(m² K). Uses solution ambient temperature and returns native boundary defaults, coefficient and committed face readback. Nonempty name/provenance required; provenance is stored as a native constraint attribute. Returns a typed constraint reference. Visible undo/rollback; does not save or solve. Reacquire selections after model/mesh/manual-session changes. Supply operation_id for safe retry.

outputSchema.description: Structured success/error envelope with additive metadata. Tool-specific payload remains extensible.
